public_rationale: Tesla’s October 21, 2026 disclosure reported that Cybercab deployment began in Austin during the third quarter and that Robotaxi service reached nearly two million cumulative unsupervised miles by quarter-end [e1]. It provides neither an operating-fleet count establishing the one-million threshold nor evidence of a decisive event making that threshold impossible through December 31, 2026 [e1].
limitations: The December 31, 2026 deadline had not passed at the October 28 evaluation date.
The evidence covers third-quarter deployment progress, not the completed year [e1].
Cumulative mileage does not establish an operating-fleet count [e1].
The disclosure was accessed through a reproduction; the official documents were inaccessible.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Elon Musk's promise of a million Tesla robotaxis, pushed back to 2026, will not be fulfilled in 2026.

statement.excerpt: Or even how he eventually walked that back to 2026 (which also won’t happen).

our_interpretation: Fulfillment means at least one million Tesla vehicles deployed in autonomous passenger taxi service by December 31, 2026.
Count operating robotaxis, including qualifying owner-supplied vehicles. Vehicle production, registrations, supervised driving subscriptions and cumulative miles do not establish this threshold.
The claim concerns the operating fleet, not one million vehicles simultaneously carrying passengers.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records covering the completed deadline establish that Tesla did not reach one million operating robotaxis during 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable deployment records establish that Tesla reached at least one million operating robotaxis during 2026.

evidence.excerpt: We began deployment of Cybercab into our Robotaxi fleet in Austin.
evidence.explanation: Tesla reported deployment progress during the third quarter. This establishes neither a million operating vehicles nor impossibility of reaching that threshold before year-end.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verified deployment records showing at least one million Tesla vehicles operating in autonomous passenger taxi service during 2026, including qualifying owner-supplied vehicles; reliable records covering the completed year establishing that the threshold was never reached; or a decisive event making fulfillment impossible through December 31, 2026.
